subject: Sport Studies
provisional_note: Semester 1 (Jul-Dec 2026) follows the official MoEST 2026 calendar. Semester 2 (Jan-May 2027) is inferred from the 2026 pattern and ends before the ACSEE examinations - replace it with the published 2026/2027 almanac before relying on those dates.

entries.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of the history of sports and its importance
entries.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate an understanding of the history and development of sports in Tanzania
entries.learning_activity: Explain the historical development of sports in Tanzania from international and national perspectives (development, spread and impacts)
teaching_learning_activities: Group discussion: Guide students in manageable groups to discuss the historical development of sports in Tanzania from international perspective
Group Discussion: Organise students in manageable groups to discuss the historical development of sports in Tanzania from national perspective
Plenary discussion: Lead plenary discussion to summarise ideals generated from the group discussions
entries.assessment: The historical development of sports in Tanzania from international and national are well explained
resources: sport sessions in television and radio
entries.references: TIE, Sport Studies for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Five: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education

entries.main_competence: 2.0 Demonstrate mastery of the relationship between human physiology and performance in sports
entries.specific_competence: 2.1 Demonstrate a basic understanding of the structure and functions of the human body systems
entries.learning_activity: Describe the structure and functions of human body systems that relate to physical exercises and sports (musculoskeletal, cardiovascular, respiratory, nervous, endocrine and digestive systems)
teaching_learning_activities: Group discussion: Task students in manageable groups to analyse the structure and functions of human body systems that relate to physical exercise and sports
entries.assessment: The structures and functions of human body systems related to physical exercises and sports are well described
entries.references: TIE, Sport Studies for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Five: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education

entries.main_competence: 2.0 Demonstrate mastery of the relationship between human physiology and performance in sports
entries.specific_competence: 2.2 Demonstrate a basic understanding of the role of human body systems and movements in sports
entries.learning_activity: Apply the knowledge of various body systems (musculoskeletal, cardiovascular, respiratory, nervous, endocrine and digestive systems) to enhance performance in physical exercises and selected sports: Athletics (running, throwing and jumping), swimming, football, netball, basketball, table tennis, tennis volleyball and handball
teaching_learning_activities: Demonstration and practice: Perform an instructional activity as students observe
Guide students to practice what they have learnt from demonstration in relation to body systems
entries.assessment: Knowledge of skeletal, muscular, circulatory, respiratory, nervous, digestive and endocrine systems are well applied in physical exercises and selected sports
entries.references: TIE, Sport Studies for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Five: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education
